headline: TRITN surges 50.00% on strong buying, driving the day's market focus.
market_take: Construction stocks showed mixed performance, with TRITN up 50.00% and PLE down 14.29%. Food sector lagged, led by MADAME (-10.42%) and AQUA (-10.00%). Property stocks were volatile, highlighted by GLAND +31.11% and PF -20.00%. PF&REITs saw heightened activity, especially PROSPECT with a volume spike of 11.1σ and a capital‑change filing.

sector_notes.note: TRITN (+50.00%) and TPOLY (-20.00%) posted the largest one‑day moves; SQ disclosed a trading‑sign filing on CS/CB placement.
MADAME and AQUA each fell around 10% intraday; XBIO showed both a -14.29% open gap and a +16.67% intraday swing, while SST recorded a 4.9σ volume spike.
GLAND jumped +31.11% amid an intraday move; PF dropped -20.00%; AKS received a high‑severity delisting notice from SET.
PROSPECT fell -7.43% despite an 11.1σ volume spike and filed a capital‑change notice on trust unit pricing; M‑STOR declined -6.25%.
GEL and DCON posted -20.00% and -6.67% moves respectively; PPP rose modestly +5.63%.
